result.reason: The redline eliminates the fixed per-day liquidated damages and replaces them with schedule relief and recovery of documented costs actually incurred, so no liquidated damages or penalty remains payable by Customer. It preserves the clause’s delay-risk allocation while adding appropriate causation, notice, cure, and sole-remedy protections. However, it is not minimal because it introduces a new affirmative cost-recovery remedy and a detailed dependency regime beyond what was necessary simply to remove the prohibited liquidated damages.
